annotations.title: Speech to text: transcribe an MP3 or WAV

description: Transcribe speech from an MP3 or WAV link into clean text with punctuation, in 50+ languages. Pick the longest the recording can be; files up to 25 MB. Compared with other audio tools: mid-priced, and one of the most used right now. Price: from $0.015 per transcript up to 5 minutes, charged only on success. Price depends on max_minutes: 1 $0.015, 5 $0.069, 15 $0.204, 30 $0.406 (default 5). One call = one transcript of up to 5 minutes (longer costs more).

audio.description: Public URL of the recording as MP3 or WAV, up to 25 MB (M4A and video files are not accepted)

language.description: Language of the speech as a 2-letter code, e.g. en; improves accuracy. Optional

max_minutes.description: Longest the recording can be; sets the price. Longer files are refused before anything runs, and not charged. Default 5

prompt.description: Names, terms or context that help spell things right. Optional
